messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty HIGH - auth-service: unusual token-reuse spike (staging) · 1785556666
meera-oncall: acknowledging, oncall taking lead. starting quick triage.
liam-eng-sre: seeing ~2400 auth succeeds with same session id across ~30 IPs, timeframe 12:12-12:18 UTC. majority originate from 3 CIDR blocks.
jordan-security: thanks. any evidence of key material or creds in logs?
liam-eng-sre: early grep shows entries like `x-api-key: sk-***TEST***` in staging-app logs forwarded to our log-forwarder. looks like the forwarder sent full request bodies to an external indexer (logseer.example.com) for a dev trial.
vikram-security: ugh. that external indexer has a public ingest endpoint. need to assume those snippets are externally accessible. treat as leaked.
meera-oncall: immediate steps: 1) stop forwarder, 2) block ingest endpoint at egress, 3) rotate staging service account keys, 4) revoke active staging sessions. doing 1 now.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: log-forwarder/staging -> scale to 0 (id: df-87f)
liam-eng-sre: applied WIP: `kubectl scale deploy/log-forwarder -n staging --replicas=0` ✅ forwarder stopped.
liam-eng-sre: applying outbound deny to ip 52.43.210.101 (logseer) via egress ACLs now.
jordan-security: start key rotations in parallel. create new service creds in secrets-manager, then rotate the staging service roles. Sam/legal, FYI.
sam-legal: on it. please record what types of data may have been in forwarded logs. we need timeline + scope for notification determination.
nora-cs: any customer data? initial grep suggests mostly internal test user ids and a couple of sandbox org tokens (org-zzz). we should pull list of unique tokens found and map to customers.
liam-eng-sre: doing `grep -E "x-api-key|Authorization" /var/log/staging/* | head -n 200` then mapping hashes. first pass: 2 tokens correlate to sandbox orgs: sandbox-alpha, sandbox-gamma. no prod orgs seen.
jordan-security: good. still treat as PII/security incident. rotate any tokens found and invalidate sessions tied to them.
meera-oncall: rotation plan: 1) create new service key, 2) update staging config + Secrets Manager, 3) deploy restart for auth-proxy. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot for controlled restart.
liam-eng-sre: running script to revoke staging sessions: `curl -X POST https://internal-api.staging/redact/revoke-sessions -d '{"filter":"env:staging AND last_seen>\"2026-03-16T12:00:00Z\""}'` — will post status.
jordan-security: please snapshot the log-forwarder config and the forwarding rule that included request bodies. I want the exact line to reproduce root cause.
liam-eng-sre: config snippet found: `forwarder.config: { "dest":"https://logseer.example.com/ingest", "include_headers": true, "include_body": true }` — changing to false for include_body.
vikram-security: make config change and redeploy but we already scaled to 0. keep copy of logs before scrub. we need to preserve evidence.
liam-eng-sre: preserving log bundle to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/staging/1785556666.tar.gz (access limited).
meera-oncall: notify customers: Nora, please prepare an outbound note to sandbox-alpha and sandbox-gamma explaining limited exposure of sandbox tokens and steps we took. Mark for review by legal.
nora-cs: drafting note, will ping Sam for signoff.
sam-legal: quick review: call out what data types, mitigation, that no production keys affected per current mapping, and offer token re-issue. include optional follow-up call.
jordan-security: I need scans of the external indexer to know if data got indexed publicly. who has domain access logs?
liam-eng-sre: checking egress logs — we see successful POSTs to logseer between 12:11:40 and 12:18:05 UTC. capturing remote response headers now.
liam-eng-sre: remote responded 200 with `index-id` for a few batches. that suggests data accepted.
vikram-security: assume data is searchable. run automated redact request to remote? we can't rely on them. assume permanent ingestion.
meera-oncall: customer impact: currently PRODUC TION unaffected. only sandbox orgs flagged. severity = high for privacy posture but low customer blast radius. escalate to incident commander for record-keeping.
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-041 (priority P2) · 1785556733
meera-oncall: I'm assigning IC to jordan-security. Jordan, you own postmortem + next steps.
jordan-security: taking IC. immediate deliverables: 1) list of leaked tokens, 2) confirm rotations, 3) evidence bundle, 4) notification draft + legal approval. timeline: update in 30m.
aya-night-oncall: I'm getting handoff at 18:00 UTC. what do you need me to watch overnight?
meera-oncall: Aya — monitor egress block, confirm no further forwarder pods start, assist with session revocation if any alerts. log any customer responses.
aya-night-oncall: ack. will take over at 18:00 UTC.
liam-eng-sre: rotations complete: new service key in Secrets Manager `staging/svckey/v2` deployed, auth-proxy restarted with zero errors. revoked 14 sessions tied to leaked tokens.
liam-eng-sre: created ticket: OPS-4682 for scrub + audit on all forwarders to disable include_body by default.
jordan-security: evidence bundle uploaded to secure bucket, access list: {security-team, eng-sre, legal}. saved findings doc: `investigation/1785556666/findings.md`.
sam-legal: reviewed customer draft, minor edits. Nora please send to sandbox-alpha & sandbox-gamma with offer to rotate tokens for them as well.
meera-oncall: next steps summary: 1) CS notify sandboxes (Nora + Sam) 2) Security postmortem + RCA (Jordan) 3) Ops rollout of forwarder hardening (Li am) 4) Night oncall monitoring (Aya) 5) PII review for evidence (Legal). I'll close this thread when handoff complete.
aya-night-oncall: confirmed egress ACLs still blocking 52.43.210.101, forwarder pods remain scaled to 0. ongoing alerts quiet.
jord an-security: scheduled follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC to kick off RCA and timeline for prod audit.
meera-oncall: thanks team. will update incident tracker and tag this thread in INC-2026-041.
liam-eng-sre: small note: doing a sweep for any other dev integrations that point at `logseer.example.com` and flagging owners. found 3 more noncritical forwards; opened PRs to flip include_body=false.
meera-oncall: closing active mitigation. Aya will take live watch. Jordan IC continues investigation. we will prepare a short customer-facing line after legal signoff. :white_check_mark:
